# Cmod A7-35T without an MMCM: TinyVGA 304x480 at the standard rates

Board configuration `cmod_a7_35_no_pll_tiny_vga_304_claude`. Русская версия: [README_ru.md](README_ru.md).

This is cmod_a7_35_tiny_vga_640_claude without an MMCM, on the 12 MHz
oscillator of Cmod A7: the labs draw on a screen of 304x480 at the standard
line and frame rates of 640x480.

The instruction, the drawings and the wiring are those of the main
configuration,
[cmod_a7_35_tiny_vga_640_claude](../cmod_a7_35_tiny_vga_640_claude/README.md);
what differs here is in its section [Without the
MMCM](../cmod_a7_35_tiny_vga_640_claude/README.md#without-the-mmcm-320x480-and-304x480).
To build the labs, pick `cmod_a7_35_no_pll_tiny_vga_304_claude` in
`./06_choose_another_fpga_board.bash` and build as described there.

| File | What it is |
|------|------------|
| [board_specific_top.sv](board_specific_top.sv) | Defines `CMOD_A7_NO_PLL_SCREEN_WIDTH` as 304 and includes the top level of cmod_a7_35_tiny_vga_640_claude, which then runs everything at 12 MHz with this VGA timing |
| [board_specific.xdc](board_specific.xdc) | The same as in cmod_a7_35_tiny_vga_640_claude |
| [board_specific.tcl](board_specific.tcl) | FPGA part for Vivado |
